export_evidence: Company website (cumi-murugappa.com, homepage): "CUMI has a wide geographical presence spanning six continents and exports products to over 60 countries." — this is a company claim, not a shipment record. ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/carborandum-universal-ltd exists but is paywalled: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world" — 0 individual shipment rows (no date, destination, HS code or B/L number) were visible to me. Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript challenge. No bill-of-lading record with date/destination/HS/B-L number could be retrieved.
domestic_evidence: Company website (cumi-murugappa.com, homepage): "CUMI's consolidated revenue is ₹4834 crores and PAT of ₹293 crores for the financial year 2024-25. CUMI, part of the 125-year-old Murugappa Group, is listed on the NSE and BSE." — a listed Indian company with disclosed consolidated revenue and domestic manufacturing/marketing operations ("Mines to Market Company whose integrated operations include mining, power generation, fusion, manufacturing, marketing and distribution"), which evidences real domestic supply activity. Exact GST turnover band and GeM/CPPP tender rows were not retrieved (annual-report and investor sub-pages returned 404 on the URLs tried).
note: Legal name in the request is misspelled: the actual entity is CARBORUNDUM UNIVERSAL LIMITED (CUMI), Chennai, part of the Murugappa Group, listed on NSE/BSE — the legal entity exists and is active, so no rejection ground applies. Declared HS codes 381600 (refractory cements/mortars/concretes) and 690320 (refractory ceramic goods, alumina/silica) match CUMI's Super Refractories and Industrial Ceramics divisions, so no HS correction is needed. Export status is 'declared_only': the company states exports to 60+ countries and it is a genuine exporter, but I could not open a single customs/B-L row (paywalls and 403s), so no dated shipment record with destination, HS code and B/L number is quoted here — per Rule 5 this stays 'заявлено, не подтверждено' rather than confirmed. Domestic supply is confirmed at the level of audited consolidated revenue (₹4834 cr FY2024-25) and disclosed manufacturing/distribution operations; the export/domestic revenue split and GST band are not public in the pages I could reach — null, not estimated. No sanctions/court issues were researched (out of scope per Rule 2).
